tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil chog yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed bzhin las rin chen do shal du zhal 'phangs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa blo dman rnams kyis rtogs par sla ba yid kyi mun sel bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra kī la ye/ bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las phur bu'i dkyil 'khor cho ga mchog /sngags 'chang gis mdzad yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed du/ /sa los rin chen do shal nyid la zhal 'phangs rnams/ /dang po'i las can don du phyogs gcig bsdebs te spel/ ༈ /'dir dpal rdo rje phur pa'i lam thams cad chu bo bzhir 'dus pa las/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhir gyur pa ni smin byed dbang gis cho ga skur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa yin pas/ de la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /de'ang sdom ni/ sngon 'gro gang zag gnas dang ni/ /sa chog sta gon rnam pa bzhi/ /dngos gzhi la yang dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /dbang bskur ba dang rnam pa gnyis/ /rjes chog rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes pa las/ spyi don dang po sngon 'gro la bzhi las/ gang zag dang gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rdo rje las rim dang dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba gnyis su blta'o/ /gsum pa sa chog la bdun te/ dkyil chog las/ sa chog la yang rnam pa bdun/ /sa gzhi bslang brtag sbyang ba dang / /byin rlabs sta gon bzung bsrung bya/ /brtag la'ang lto 'phye chu sa'i bkra/ /sbyang la'ang phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ /gzung la blo dang stangs stabs kyi/ /bzung ba rnam gnyis gnyis pa la/ /gsol ba btab dang bgegs bskrad pa'o/ /bskrad la byin rlabs bka' bsgo dang / /stangs stabs rnam gsum bsrung ba la/ /phur gdab srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /zhes pa las sa blang ba la/ snang ba las blang ba dang / sa brtag pa gnyis dgos na rtogs par sla ba bzhin no/ /mi snang ba las blang ba ni/ gang du 'os pa'i sar me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i khar man 'dzu bcugs la de'i steng du dpal chen po'i gtor ma bshams/

mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams la/ byang shar du sa'i lha mo'i sgos mchod/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ gtor ma gcig rnams dang / gzhan yang srung ma'i gtor ma sogs ji ltar dgos pa dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ bsnyen phur dang / 'og tu dgos pa'i gdab phur bcu la yungs dkar gyi thum bu dang / dar gyi cod pan gdags pa/ gu gul dri bzang dang chang bsres pa/ rnga/ cha lang / dung la sogs pa yo byad tshang bar 'dus byas la/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du/ gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis chus sbyangs/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭ/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ratna bhañdzā oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra a karṣa ya dzaḥ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a dyā nutpan na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ gsum gyis phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ /sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar/ /khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi/ /ci bde bar ni gzhan du song / /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang /

'jug cing dbang blang ba sogs bgyid na/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / dngos grub bsgrub pa'i gtong grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sarba bighnan gatstsha/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ sogs brjod/ sa brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa rnams la ni mi dgos la/ dgos pa'i sar rtogs par sla ba bzhin bya'o/ /sa sbyang ba la/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa yan chad sa lo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed bzhin mdzad nas/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor bsngo bshags pa yan chad tshar ba dang / sbyang ba dngos ni/ rang gi mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ g.yon par a las zla ba as mtshan pa/ hūm̐/ g.yas pa'i spyan zur la gnas pa'i/ /ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'od kyis snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg par bya/ /mahā surya maṇḍa la/ da hā da hā bhasmi ku ru hūm̐/ yaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las byung ba yi/ /yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dngos kun bsregs pa'i thal ba yang / /thams cad ma lus gtor bar bya/ /yaṃ bā yu maṇḍa la bhakṣa re ṇa ku ru/ g.yon pa'i spyan zur las byung ba'i/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'od kyis snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /thams cad ma lus bkru bar bya/ /a tsanda maṇḍa la sa ṇa pa ku ru/ oṃ shu n+yā ta sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho ko3haṃ/ nang gi sbyang ba ni/ sna tshogs 'di dag 'khrul pa las snang yang don dam par chos kyi dbyings nyid do/ /oṃ dharmā dha tu swa bha wa shuddha3haṃ/ gsang ba'i sbyang ba ni/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭ dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/

yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa sa gzhir thim pas bde ba chen po'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ bo dhi tsitta swa bhā wa bi shuddhe bha wantu/ sa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ pā padma maṇḍa la/ padma'i gdan du gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang gyur gshegs/ /zhes lan gsum/ thal mo g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa lan gsum sa la reg ngag tu/ sa 'og gnas pa'i lha mo thon/ padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mdog ser mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rnal 'byor bka' stsal ji ltar bgyid/ ces smras pa/ oṃ badzra a ra li nas/ oṃ bi pu ra ye hūm̐ gis mchod pa'i bar rol chen mdzad/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'bru gsum dang / rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇa a dyā nutpan na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ lan gsum 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ shākya seṅge skyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir dpang gyur lha mos kyang / /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ces lan gsum dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs kyi skabs su slob ma yod na/

'jug cing dbang blang ba'i mthar/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la sogs pa bgyid na/ sogs 'jug go /sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ khyod ni slob dpon dam pa yin/ /sems can don phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /oṃ pri thi wi de wi badzra muḥ lha mo sa de nyid la thim pas gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ ces brjod la mchod gtor tshom bu dman pa rnams gzhan du gsol/ sa sta gon ni/ sngar dung chos sogs su bshams pa'i dri bzang chang dang bsres pa 'thor yab kyis tshigs bcad re'i mjug gi sngags dang bstun dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sa gzhi la gtor te/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings dag pa'i bdud rtsi mi bskyod pa/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ mahā mu traṃ maṇḍa la hūm̐/ de bzhin du 'don pa sgyur zhing rigs 'gre sbyar la/ me long dag pa'i bdud rtsi rnam snang 'di/ /rgyal ba'i sku yiྎ bka' gsangྎ gsang ba'iྎ oṃ mahā bi dra maṇḍa la oṃ/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i bdud rtsi rakta 'di/ /rgyal ba'i yon tanྎ bka' gsangྎ gsang ba'iྎ oṃ mahā ru dhi ra maṇḍa la swa/ kun rtog dag pa'i bdud rtsi byang sems 'di/ /rgyal ba'i gsung giྎ bka' gsangྎ gsang ba'iྎ oṃ mahā shukla maṇḍa la ā/ bya grub dag pa'i bdud rtsi sha chen 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin lasྎ bka' gsangྎ gsang ba'iྎ oṃ mahā maṃ sa maṇḍa la ha/ zhal nas hūm̐ hūm̐ rab brjod pas/ /thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /phyogs mtshams steng 'og rdo rje dang / /gur las me 'od 'bar bar gyur/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sngags 'di la dri bzang mi 'thor/ sa blos bzung ba la/ bdag ni sems can don bya'i phyir/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang byos shig /rin chen sna tshogs phye btags pas/ /bdag gis don yod dkyil 'khor bri/

/zhes brjod cing sems can gyi don du dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lam nyams su len pa'i bsod nams 'dis/ bdag sangs rgya ba'i dus su bdud dpa' bkong ba'i tshe/ lha mo khyod kyis dpang mdzod cig snyam du bsam mo/ /stangs stabs kyis bzung ba'i gsol ba btab pa'i skabs su slob dpon gtso bo'i mdog dang mthun pa'i chas gos gyon la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su khri'u chung la khyel byas nas shar du gzigs pa'i mdun stegs kyi steng du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang / nang mchod rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru rnams bshams te/ phyogs bzhir rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams kyis rim pas cig car du mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐/ nas/ bi pu ta'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang / rol mo dang bstun ḍā dril mdzad/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pa la bandha mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ /zhes pas nang mchod dang / de nas rnam rgyal gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob mas gtso bo'i shar nas/ de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ mchog tu gsang ba yum gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa rtag tu sbyor/ /gnyis med thig le byang chub dag pa'i sku/ /byang chub rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sku/ /phyag rgya rdzogs pa kun gyi gnas/ /mtha' gnyis las ni rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ zhes dang /

lho sogs kyi skabs su slob dpon zhal bsgyur zhing / mchod pa chu dang me tog kha gsos/ lha bshos dang mar me gsar pa spo/ byin rlabs phyi mchod nang mchod sogs sngar bzhin byas nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ lho nas thams cad dbang bsdud ma'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ rol pa'i cho 'phrul che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /bka' yi 'khor lo gsang ba'i yon tan ston/ /thugs rje'i cho 'phrul chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /gsang sngags bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dur dbyangs dang / 'chi bdag bdud ni tshar gcod cing / /mi mthun log lta 'joms mdzad pa/ /yon tan rin chen kun gyi gnas/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang / rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pas nub nas 'dod chags khros pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ gsung gi thigs pa thugs kyi rgya mtsho'i klong / /lung dang man ngag gtan tshigs chos kyi mdzod/ /dus gsum rnal 'byor dbang phyug bsgrod pa'i shul/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam par sbyong / /rdo rje gsung ni kun 'byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ byang nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs kyi thugs/ /mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin byed pa'i/ /smra ba'i seṅge chen por dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje'i las mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / khams gsum kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /'byung gnas kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon langs te khri'u chung dang mchod pa sogs bsdus nas/ badzra kī la kī la ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas gtso bo'i nga rgyal bzung la byang shar du phyin/

dbus su kha bstan la/ rang gi mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ g.yon par a las zla ba as mtshan pa/ mā surya maṇḍa la/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje re re gyur/ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra/ g.yas g.yon spyan zur ma a las/ /byung ba'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las/ /spros pa'i 'od kyis bgegs tshogs kun/ /thams cad ma lus bskrad par bya/ /badzra tiṣṭha ma ā/ g.yas g.yon spyan zur ma a las/ /byung ba'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las/ /spros pa'i rdo rje rab 'bar ba/ /phyogs kun rdo rje ra bar gyur/ /kro dha tiṣṭha ma a/ bka' bsgo ba'i tshe dbang ldan nas dbus su zhal phyogs pas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil/ gzhan yang rol mo rnams brtsam zhing dgu brdungs brdeg stod smad du 'theng brdungs gsum gsum dang bstun la 'chams shing / dam tshig chen po'i 'gros bzhin byas la gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /'byung po sha za srin po'i tshogs/ /gang dag gnas pa myur du song / /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' byung nas/ /gang dag mi 'gro de rnams la/ /ye shes rdo rje rtse dgu yis/ /mgo nas brgyab pa rting par 'gems/ /zhes dang / rol mo gong bzhin gyi mjug tu/ kī la ya dang / hūm̐ drag tu bzlas yungs dkar gyis brab cing bskor ba byas/ byang shar du bslebs pa dang gong bzhin dgu brdung sogs byed/ mchod g.yog pas slob dpon gyi sngon la gu gul gyis bdug go /de 'dra ba lan gsum bya zhing / hūm̐ gi sgra drag tu bsgrags la nyi ma zla ba rdo rje las 'od zer byung bas gdug pa can rnams bsregs bcom/ lhag ma rnams gzhan du byer par bsam mo/ /stangs stabs dngos la 'dir sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i 'chams dpe snang ba 'gyur thub bzhin rtsa 'cham rdzogs par mdzad rjes/ khro bo bcu'i stangs stabs dbyangs dang bcas ban phur thogs nas bya'o/

/bsdu ba dang spros bcas mi shom na khro bcu'i stangs stabs rkyang pas chog 'cham tshul 'cham dper gsal/ oṃ hūm̐ chen ka ra'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis thal sbyar gyen du bsgrengs/ /rkang gnyis mthil sbyar thur du zug /tshigs chen bzhi yang bcag par bya/ /oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol byas nas/ /mche ba gtsigs shing zhal bgrad pa'i/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /oṃ badzra kro dha bī dza/ sogs/ dbyug pa sngon po'i phyag rgya ni/ /g.yon pa dku la bsten nas ni/ /g.yas pa'i gung dang mdzub gnyis bsgreng / /'ded pa'i tshul du byas pa yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha ni la/ sogs/ gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya ni/ /g.yas pa gdengs shing khu tshur bcangs/ /g.yon pa dku la brten pa ni/ /gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha ya man/ sogs/ mi g.yo mgon po'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis spar mo gdengs nas ni/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su 'phyar ba ni/ /mi g.yo mgon po'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha arya/ sogs/ rta mgrin rgyal po'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis spyi bo'i rgya bcings nas/ /lus po brdung ba bstan pa ni/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya/ sogs/ gzhan gyis mi thub phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis spar mo gdengs byas nas/ /'dzin pa'i stabs su byas pa ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta/ sogs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis dku la brten nas ni/ /sked pa brdung pa bstan pa ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta/ sogs/ khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya ni/ /g.yas pa dku la brten byas nas/ /g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe chung mnan/ /gsum po 'dzin pa lcags kyu'i tshul/ /oṃ badzra kro dha trai lokya/

sogs/ stobs po che yi phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis sor mo bsnol nas ni/ /steng nas gnon pa lta bu bya/ /stobs po che yi phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ badzra kro dha mahā bā la/ sogs dang / steng dang phyogs kyi khro bo rnams/ /rkang g.yon brang bzhag g.yas nang bskor/ /'og dang mtshams kyi khro bo ni/ /g.yon pa nang du bskor bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar khro bcu rol pa'i skabs rnams bya'o/ /sa bsrung ba'i tshe/ gong du 'dus byas pa'i phur bu bcu gu gul gyis bdugs te/ e spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ sarba sha trun bighnan dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta/ sogs dang / kī la ya'i rjes la/ rakṣa rakṣa sogs brjod cing / yungs kar gyis brabs/ phur bu rnams stod khro bo bcu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra sogs brjod/ khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa mang po spros te/ phyogs bcu'i dbang po la sogs pa'i ming gzugs 'dzin pa'i bgegs rnams bkug nas/ rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol tu hūm̐ las grub pa'i khron pa bcur bcug par bsam zhing phur bu bsgril la/ kī la ya ci rigs bzlas/ slob dpon shar du blta bas slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang / g.yon pas rdo rje phur bu rnams bzung la/ slob ma rnams ban dha lag pa g.yas dang / phur pa g.yon du bzung nas dbyangs dang bcas pas/ dzaḥ steng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /hūm̐ mdzad dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can/ /zhal nas kī la ya yi sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i gdon rnams bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ sogs brjod cing / kī la ya gsum gyi bar du 'gros byas/ de nas rol mo chems brdung dang / oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣṭaṃ phaṭ/

kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti swāhā'i bar brjod cing / bsgral mchod kyi rnga bzhin drag myur brdungs la phur pa steng du 'debs pa'i stengs ka byas la shar du 'dzugs/ de bzhin du/ shar phyogs dri za bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rnam rgyalྎ zhal nasྎ dri za'i gdonྎ oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya sogs/ shar lho me lhaྎ dbyug sngonྎ zhal nasྎ me lha'iྎ oṃ badzra kro dha ni la danḍa/ sogs/ lho phyogs gshin rjeྎ gshin rje dbu gsumྎ zhal nasྎ gshin rje'iྎ oṃ badzra kro dha ya manta ka sogs/ lho nub srin poྎ mi g.yo dbuྎ zhal nasྎ srin po'iྎ oṃ badzra kro dha arya a tsa la/ sogs/ nub phyogs chu lhaྎ rta mgrinྎ zhal nasྎ chu lha'iྎ oṃ badzra kro dha ha yaྎ nub byang rlung lhaྎ 'dod rgyalྎ zhalྎ rlung lha'iྎ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra/ sogs/ byang phyogs gnod sbyinྎ 'khyil paྎ zhal nasྎ gnod sbyinྎ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta/ sogs/ byang shar bgegs bdagྎ khams gsumྎ zhal nasྎ bgegs bdagྎ oṃ badzra kro dha trai lokya/ sogs/ 'og phyogs sa bdagྎ stobs chenྎ zhal nasྎ oṃ badzra kro dha mahā ba la/ sogs brjod cing / 'og tu 'debs tshul dang / nub tu btsugs la bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas phur bu btab pas rkang mthil du phub ste/ gser gyi sa gzhi la phug pas lus g.yo 'gul med cing / sems rtog med bde chen gyi ngo bor gyur nas khro bo bcus bgegs bsrung ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /zhes pa nas/ bhañdza ratna hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin brjod cing / de nas 'cham chas rnams bzhag la/ srung ma rnams kyi bskang ba dang bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar grub nas tshogs dang rjes chog rnams mngon rtogs 'bring bsdus gang rung bzhin bya'o// ༈ //bzhi pa sta gon la bzhi/

dkyil chog las/ sta gon la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /thig gdab lha dang bum pa dang / /slob ma sta gon gnas pa 'o/ /thig la'ang ye shes las thig go /lha rnams sta gon gnas pa la/ /lha bskyed mchod bstod snyan gsan dbab/ /slob ma sta gon gnas pa la/ /spro bskyed sdom bzung byin gyis brlabs/ /gsor shing dri chu chos bshad pa/ /ku sha srung skud gtor ma btang / /mchod sogs rmi brtag cho ga 'o/ /zhes pa las/ dang po thig gdab pa la gnyis kyi/ las thig ni dkyil chog bzhin no/ /ye shes kyi thig ni/ cho ga'i go rim bzhin rjes su 'chad do/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ bshoms kyi skabs su rdo rje phur pa'i zhing khams ma la sogs pa yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa la dpal chen po 'di nyid kyi gtor ma lnga stod zur gsum la smad zlum po mtheb kyus brgyan pa la/ mar gyis nor bu la sogs ci mdzes byas pa'i g.yas su sman phud chang gtsang ma la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ g.yon du rakṣa khrag gtsang ma'am sha dmar chang la btab pa ste gnyis ka'i snod thod pa'am thod pa'i gzugs bzos pa rdo sogs gang rnyed du bya/ gzhan yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi dam rdzas dang / bskang ba byed na bskang gtor sogs rang rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ thig btab pa'i lha gnas rnams su dbus gru bzhi dang / 'khor rnams la zlum por dri bzang gis byugs pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa bkod/ dam can gyi snam bu la phyogs rnams su bdun bdun dang / mtshams rnams su gsum re ste bzhi bcu bkod/ tshom bu yum la mi bkod/ mthar dur khrod kyi steng la chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa khor mar bshams/ 'dod snam gyi steng du sgos mchod la 'khor lo rgyas 'debs re bcu drug mdzad/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/

nang mchod/ sras mchog lnga/ bum pa bcu gcig gam gnyis/ slob ma sta gon dgos na de dag gi yo byad rnams dang / yang stegs gcig tu tshon sna lnga/ dbus su sngon po/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu la dbus nas rim pa bzhin/ hūm̐ a swā hā a rnams bris/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud kyang bkod/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma sa chog gi mi snang ba la snang ba'i skabs ltar btang ste/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi gong du mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta/sogs kyis bsang / swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrum̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ban dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang / 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu zhig bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra a ha ra li sogs brjod/ rnga byin rlabs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar bar bya/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa'i bar sgrub thabs 'bring po ltar gyi dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa'i bar mdzad pas/ 'di la phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar phur 'bring ltar mdzad/ de nas 'khor ba phur bu sogs bzhag la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum zhes sogs la dbyangs byed/ yang dag don du dang /

bde bar gshegs so sogs dang / bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /nas/ karma kro ti sho ri a zhes pa'i bar byas la/ de'i rjes su rol mo gsum brdeg lan can byas la rol cha rnams bzhag de nas sta gon gyi tshom bu la dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharmā dha tu badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad pas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ keṃ bhruṃ/ e bhruṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ e a sha maṇḍa la/ yaṃ wa yu maṇḍa la/ baṃ u ta ka maṇḍa la/ raṃ te dzwa maṇḍa la/ laṃ pri thi wi maṇḍa la/ raṃ rakta dzo la maṇḍa la/ keṃ mahā kā la su me ru maṇḍa la/ bhruṃ bi shuddhe dzwa la maṇḍa la/ e tre ko naṃ dzwa la badzra pra ka ra ne mi wardha maṇḍa la/ bhruṃ da sha a ra tsakra maṇḍa la/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng waṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bhruṃ las rin chen sna lnga'i rang bzhin las/ /legs grub dwangs shing thogs med gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bzhi shel gser byu ru margad mdog /lte ba bai ḍūrya yi rang bzhin can/ /steng logs ka ba rtsig pa gdung la sogs/ /kun kyang rin chen lnga las legs grub cing /

/'khor lo rin chen pad ral rdo rjes mtshan/ /rgya phub rtse mo rdo rje nor bu'i tog /sgo bzhi rin chen bzhi yi rin chen las/ /rab mdzes rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /steng gi kha rin chen du mas spras/ /bya 'dab las 'phyang gser gyi skud pas brgyus/ /rnga yab zla ba rdo rje phyed pa dang / /dar 'phyang sogs kyis brgyan pa'i do shal dang / /do shal phyed pas 'khor yug kun tu spras/ /steng du mda' yab padma phyed pa'i dbyibs/ /thur du rin chen shar bus rnam par mdzes/ /'og gi stegs bur gzugs mas me long thogs/ /sgra mas gling bu dri mas dung chos thogs/ /ro mas zhal zas reg mas na bza' dang / /dbyings mas chos 'byung sgeg mas rdo rje dang / /'phreng mas 'phreng ba glu mas pi waṃ dang / /gar mas rdo rje me tog me tog snod/ /spos mas spos dang mar mes sgron me'i snod/ /rdza rngas rdza rnga chen mo rdza rngas mchod/ /gzhal yas dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /mu khyud rdo rje rwa bas rnam par spras/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur/ /gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu rab tu 'bar/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /shing me mchod rten chu bo grub pa brgyad/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin srin po dang / /sha za smyo byed brjed byed ro langs dang / /mdung dang gsal shing rtse yis phug pa'i ro/ /ro dum thod tshal sha khrag rus pas dkrigs/ /wa dang ce spyang khwa 'ug bya rgod dang / /keṃ ka la sogs pheṃ sgra sgrog pas gang / /dzaḥpā padma maṇḍa la/ mā surya maṇḍa la/ ā tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la/ mahā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ bra hma dzaḥ int+ra dzaḥ aggi dzaḥ ya ma dzaḥ ni ri te dzaḥ wa ru ṇa dzaḥ ba ya we dzaḥ ku be ra dzaḥ i shwa ra dzaḥ bhu mi pa ti dzaḥ ma tri dzaḥ ma traṃ dzaḥ gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ sgril ma bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa las/

dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnan bandha hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum brjod/ dkyil 'khor dbus su khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me phung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur bsgril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha sbub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis/ /ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcus do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le sor ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyangs bskums gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭ/ steng gi phyogs kyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril/ /sprul pa phag dang smig bu'i mgo

/oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ shar gyi phyogs kyiྎ khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje sgeg moྎ sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ni la daṇḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭ/ me yi mtshams kyiྎ khro bo chen po dbyug sngon can/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje sder moྎ sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ya manta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭ/ lho yi phyogs kyiྎ khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje dur khrodྎ sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha arya a tsa la hūm̐ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭ/ lho nub mtshams kyiྎ khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje gtun khungྎ sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hūm̐ hū lu hū lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ nub kyi phyogs kyiྎ khro bo chen po rta mgrin dpal/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje gtum moྎ sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ byang gi phyogsྎ khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje sgra mdzadྎ sprul pa seṅge pha waṃ mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭ/ byang shar mtshamsྎ khro chen khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje gsod maྎ sprul pa dred dang sbre mong mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha mahā ba la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'og gi phyogs kyiྎ khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /dbu gsumྎ rdo rje rig byedྎ sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo /khro chen yab rnams thams cad ni/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /tha mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/ /yum rnams phyag g.yas dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /sprul pa'i khra thabs nyi shu po/ /g.yas pas rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pas phur sgril ro steng bzhugs/

/oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra bai ro bhai hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badzra ma ra ni hūm̐ hoḥ shar sgor pu shud mgo can ni/ /mdog dkar 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu bsnams/ /lho sgor bya rog mgo can ni/ /mdog ser 'ching ba'i zhags pa bsnams/ /nub sgor srin bya'iྎ mdog dmar sdom byed lcags sgrog bsnams/ /byang sgor khra yiྎ ljang gu myos byed dril bu bsnams/ /khro chen 'khor bcas yab yum rnams/ /rgyan rnams yab yum tshul bzhin te/ /kun kyang rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ /me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra yo gi shwa ri aṣṭa bem sha ti hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra kī la kī la ya dha ti ma ma shrī ghaṃ karma ka ra mā ra se na pra mardha ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim khor yug na/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis sogs/ /dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par gyur/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa'i lha tshogs badzra sa ma dzaḥ 'khor ba phur bu/ sogs dang / oṃ e hya hi bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka tri shya hoḥ sa mā ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra bhe sha ya phaṭ/ a bhe sha ya a/ a ti pa ho/ pra ni pa dzaḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra pā da bandha naṃ ka ro mis dam tshig pas ye shes pa la phyag bya/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra hasta tsa pā dyaṃ pra titstsha badzra a pa na tiṣṭhantu/ zhes pas zhabs bsil gdan la bzhugs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thata khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi/ sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /sogs kyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/

thabs kyi spyod pas sogs kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ mchod bstod ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka la thun mong du yin pas/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni a mṛ tas bsang / swa bha was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las a las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra shapda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra utta pha la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra biṣpu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa dgos pa rnams 'di bzhin no/ /sgeg 'phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang ste/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /sogs kyi rjes la/ badzra la sya hūm̐/ badzra mā le traṃḥ badzra girti hrīḥ badzra nirti āḥ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ badzra dhu pe hūm̐/ badzra a lo ke hrīḥ badzra gandhe āḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapda āḥhūm̐ gis rol chen dang / gandhe ra ṇi sogs mdzad/ mchod pa bsdus pa rnams 'di bzhin mdzad/ de ltar gyi mchod pa sogs nas/ nang mchod ni/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /nas/ tsitta siddhi hūm̐ gi bar bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed bzhin dang / gsang mchod/ 'khril pa'i mchod chen sngags bcas/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'am khams gsum yongs su bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po ste/ /sogs sngags bcas/ bsgral mchod gdab kha dang po sogs sngags bcas kyi mthar/

kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod/ de nas/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu sogs nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar sngags bcas brjod cing / gtor ma'i steng du rakta bsgreng / kha 'phang 'di rnams sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin no/ /bstod pa ni/ sgeg cing dpa' dang / zhes sogs nas/ de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ /e ka dza ti gu hya gsang ba'i yum/ /tshur byonྎ thugs rjeྎ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin sogs nas/ de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byonྎ thugs rjeྎ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung dam can rnams/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /bdag nyid chen po shwa na mu kha dang / /sa bdag chen mo bse yi lha mo bzhi/ /ci phyin ya phyin bse phyin phag phyin ma/ /tshur byonྎ thugs rjeྎ de nas/ 'dod chags khros pa'i me ni/ sogs nas/ khong stong byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ci nus byas la/ bzlas pa bsdu ba na/ ma rakmo sogs zhi snying gcig tu dril ba cung zad bzlas la/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug nas kha rlangs phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs nas/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin brjod/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sogs shlau ka gcig byas nas/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos bzung / g.yon dril bu gsil zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i klong dkyil na/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /khro bo khro mo rnams bzhugs pa/ /bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/

/ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag bdag gis ni/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bas 'dir bzhugs nas/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon la/ bum pa rnams 'khyil pas bsang / swa bha was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bhruṃ las byung ba'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ kha yel ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bcu'i/ de'i phyi'i phyogs bzhi rnams su paṃ las padma dang / a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga/ las thams cad pa'i bum par padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ ljang sngon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu nas/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ de'i pang na yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /kyi bar dang / shar gyi g.yas kyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril/ /shar gyi g.yon gyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal/ /sogs khra thabs bor la gong bzhin dang / nub kyi g.yas kyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po rta mgrin dpal/ /sogs dang / nub kyi g.yon gyi gdan steng du/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /sogs dang / nub byang mtshams kyi gdan steng du/ /khro chen gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/

/rdo rje gsod byed sku la 'khril/ /gyi bar dang / khro chen yab rnams thams cad ni/ /nas/ yab la stobs/ kyi bar dang / shar phyogs pu shud mgo can ni/ nas/ ljang khu gsod byed dril bu bsnams/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / las kyi bum par 'khyil pa dkar dmar dbus zhal ljang / /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rgya gram be con bsnams/ /tha mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/ /lha mo rdo rje sgra mdzad ljang / /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /brkyangs bskums gar gyis gnyis med rol/ /khro chen 'khor bcas yab yum rnams/ /nas/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa 'khor bcas oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wakka tsitta badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ thabs kyi spyod pas/ sogs kyis dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad la khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ sgeg 'phreng glu gar/ sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /sogs shlau ka gcig mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /shin tu mi zad dpal chen he ru ka /phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i tshogs rnams thugs las sprul/ /rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs skyong dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /bdud 'dul khro chen ye shes khro bo bcu/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyis srid gsum 'gro ba sgrol/ /khro rgyal yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byams sogs tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug dang 'dra ba la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi gtor zhing / /thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i dbyings su 'khyil/

/khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ pad skor gyis gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar/ bsams la/ kī la ya sogs lha bco lnga'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ci rigs brgya rtsa bzlas te/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yi ge brgya pa dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ kī la ya/ brjod cing / dung chos kyi chu blugs pas/ lha rnams 'od du zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas yi dam chos bsrung rnams la gtor bsngo bshag pa/ bskang ba bstod pa rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba bya/ tshogs byin rlabs sogs sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin dang / thun gtor 'bul ba sogs bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin rlabs bsdus pa byas nas/ sgeg 'phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog la/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yis mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /badzra lā sya hūm̐ sogs rol chen/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas/ shlau ka gcig gis nang mchod bstod pa/ sgeg cing dpa' nas bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar brjod/ ye shes lnga ldan gyis dngos grub blang / yig brgya brjod/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ badzra tiṣṭha/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar nam mkhar bzhugs nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ sgeg 'phreng sogs gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ mdun gyi gtor mgron rnams gshegs gsol dang / brtan bzhugs ci rigs par byas nas/

bdag la dkyil 'khor bsdus nas cho ga bgo ba/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /tshogs pa rnams so sor gyes la/ slob dpon gyi mdun du sngar bshams pa'i tshon sna lnga dang / thig skud sogs dang / de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ gong tshon gyi yi ge rnams slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses sngon po la hūm̐/ dkar po la oṃ/ ser po la swā/ dmar po la āḥ ljang gu la ha rnams bri'o/ /de nas thig chen rnams 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi zla'i gdan lnga'i dbus su dbang phyug yab yum/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi gdan/ rang skad cig gis gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭ kyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma as mtshan par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ yab yum snyoms par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar thig le babs/ hūm̐ oṃ swa a ha lngar gyur pa yum gyi mkha' nas gdan steng du babs te zhu ba las sras mchog rigs lnga'i skur gyur pa ni/ dbus su badzra kī la ya/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me phung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi phyag gis bsnams/ /tha gnyis phur sgril sku che rags/ /shar du buddha kī la ya/ /smug nagྎ rdo rje rtse dgu 'khor lo dang / /me phungྎྎྎ sogs/ lho ru ratna kī la ya/ /ser nagྎ rdo rje rtse dgu rin chen dang / /me phungྎྎྎ nub tu padma kī la ya/ /dmar nagྎ rdo rje rtse dgu padma dang / /me phungྎྎྎ byang du karma kī la ya/ /ljang nagྎ

rdo rje rtse dgu rgya gram dang / /ྎྎྎ tha gnyis phur sgril sku che rags/ /ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ badzra a ha ra/ sogs kyis mchod/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma badzra sa mā ya hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas tshon dang / oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes thig byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags gnyis nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas/ de nas srad bu rnams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsams la/ de'i 'od kyis sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ yig 'bru gsum la thim ste 'od du zhu ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis babs par bsamasal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ji ltar rigs pa bzla ste/ slob dpon gyis thig skud rnams bsdus/ tshon gyi yi ge rnams mtheb srin g.yon gyis bsub la sngon po'i rigs rnams la sngon nas cung zad re bsre/ de bzhin dkar po sogs gzhan rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi rdo rje slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa la thig skud sngon po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu rnams rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyi don bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems ni gcig tu gyur/ /oṃ ā n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmāḥspha ra spha ra/ a nu pra biṣṭaḥ sarba dharmāḥ badzra añdza li/ a dyanta a nu pra biṣṭa/ sarba dharmāḥ badzra bandha/ ces brjod cing dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig bsgril bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par bsams la/

rdo rje la dkris te mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la bzhag go /de nas slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas langs la thig skud dkris pa'i rdo rje rang gi lte ba'i thad du bzung / dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar la kha bltas/ slob ma rdor dril 'dzin pas shar nas nub tu kha phyogs pa la/ karmā badzra dzdzaḥ gnyis brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzdzaḥganyis brjod cing thig sna blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung / slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya su tra mā ti pra ma hūm̐/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /zhes brjod de dang por steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas sa la phab nas thig chen brgyad dang logs thig rnams btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam/ de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la tshangs thig dang po gdab bo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni gong du bshad pa ltar slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de nas nam mkha' dang sa la 'debs tshul tshig brjod pa rnams gong bzhin thams cad du shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis rgyab sprod tshul du slob ma'i rgyab nas bskor te lho dang / slob mas rgyab sprod tshul du slob dpon gyi rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas shar lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas byang shar du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas nub byang dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas lho nub tu gnas pas nub kyi logs thig gdab/

slob dpon de nyid dang slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas byang shar du gnas pas byang gi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas shar lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas lho nub tu gnas pas lho'i logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang / slob ma nub byang du phyin la zur thig dang po gdab/ slob dpon lho nub tu phyin/ slob ma byang shar du phyin te zur thig gnyis pa gdab bo/ /de nas slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas thig skud slob dpon gyis rdo rje la dkris shing bsdus la/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badzra be gā kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye thig nam mkhar btegs nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin te kha shar la blta bas gzhi bca' pad bskor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu dkur bstan te/ hriḥhriḥ zhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas bskor du bltas pas sgo rnams dbye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chu slob dpon gyi rdor dril dang bcas bzhin pas srin lag gnyis kyis dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbyi bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod cing thig phyi'o/ /ye thig skor ba bya lugs 'di la dkyil 'khor zhal shar bstan kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ gnas khang sogs dgos byed stabs nas dkyil 'khor zhal lho dang / nub dang / byang rnams la blta dgos byung tshe/ phyogs dkyil 'khor dang bstun/ mtshams 'jig rten pa dang bstun dgos te/ nag po dkyil chog las/ 'jig rten dbang ldan du bla ma mi 'gro ba dang / rnal 'byor pa'i phyogs dang 'jig rten pa'i phyogs so sor shes pa gal che'o/

/zhes gsungs pas slob ma mer 'gro mi nyan pa'ang shugs bstan gyis shes so/ /des na dkyil 'khor zhal lho dang / nub dang / byang du bstan na/ rnal 'byor pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi shar ni dkyil 'khor zhal gang la bstan pa de yin no/ /de bzhin du lho dang byang yang shes so/ /mtshams ni gong du bshad pa ltar 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa kho na dgos pa'i phyir ma 'khrul ba gal gnad che bas slob dpon du gyur pa rnams kyis rtog pa zhib la blangs/ tshangs thig gnyis g.yas skor du dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs dang bstun/ logs thig zur thig gdab lugs dkyil 'khor zhal gang la bstan rung zhal shar bstan bzhin 'jig rten pa'i shar lho nges pa can no/ /bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed du blta'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dkyil chog las/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la yang gsum/ /dkyil 'khor bri dang byin gyis brlab/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i rim pa 'o/ /zhes pa las/ dang po bri ba la gsum ste/ de nyid las/ bri la tshon bkye'i rim pa dang / /mtshan ma dgod dang rgyan dgram pa'o/ /zhes pa las/ dang por tshon dgye ba ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du phyogs par 'dug la/ byang shar nas rtsig pa sgo tshad gcig tsam slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bri zhing / hūm̐/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /de byung rigs lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems can ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /tshon gyi las 'di bdag gis brtsams/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma badzra sa mā ya hūm̐ a/ zhes brjod cing nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams cung zad bri/ de nas lag pa g.yas sam/ slob ma gzhan gyis rtsig pa byin dang sbom phra mthun par bris tshar ba dang /

ting zhabs can gyi kha bcad nas zan sogs kyis mi 'chug par byas la zhabs ra'i steng du ye thig rdo rje tshon skud dkris pa de bzhag yid kyis me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lnga phul/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu/ sngon po rnams kyis bkang la/ slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim par bris/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na ting bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma'i tshon bkra brtag pa ste/ rtsig pa gzhan las dma' ba byung na dngos grub mi thob pas ngan/ mtho na dngos grub 'byung bas bzang / yon po dang skyog po byung na bgegs zhugs pas bar chad kyi rtags yin te ngan/ shin tu 'drong na bar chad med pas bzang / rtsig pa chad na dpon slob gnyis ka 'chi bas shin tu ngan/ ma chad na bzang ngo / /ngan pa rnams byung na bsnyen phur lag tu bzung / kī la ya brgya rtsa sogs gang mang bzlas rjes phur bus btab cing / oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba sha trun hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod cing dbang ldan rtsig pa'i ri mo bsub ste slar bri'o/ /bzang na yid kyi mchod pa lngas mchod/ tshon gyi kha dog ni/ dbus kyi chos 'byung mthing nag mu khyud ljang / /mu khyud steng du rdo rje nag po bri/ /zla gam gsum dmar mtha' skor mu khyud ljang / /'khor lo'i kha dog ser pos rab tu mdzes/ /mu khyud phyi ma rdo rje'i gdung yin pas/ /sngon po'i steng du rdo rje ser po bri/ /rtsibs chen phyogs mdog 'dod yon dmar po la/ /lha mo'i mtshan ma me tog bcu drug bri/ /sgo 'gram zur rnams zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan/ /pha gu ser po shing ris nag pos bya/ /de steng mtshams sogs rin chen phra tshom bri/ /dra ba'i gzhi nag dra ba dkar po dang / /shar bu'i gzhi ni rtsa ba lcags nag la/ /kha ni sngo skya de steng dkar po yis/ /spyi blugs mgo ni mthur bstan 'dra ba bri/ /mda' yab gzhi dkar padma phyed pa'i dbyibs/

/nag pos bri zhing dmar sngo ljang sogs kyi/ /sna tshogs tshon gyis ci mdzes bri bar bya/ /mun pa glang rgyab gnyis ka nag pos 'gengs/ /glang rgyab steng du me tog dar dpyangs bri/ /ka ba ra rnams phyogs mdog ka rgyan dang / /chu srin ci mdzes rta babs dang po dmar/ /gnyis pa sngo la gsum pa ljang khu dang / /bzhi pa ser po de steng g.yas g.yon du/ /ri dwags gser mdog padma 'khor lo gdugs/ /ci mdzes nyi dkyil ljang khu pad ra ni/ /dkyil sngo mtha' rnams dmar ljang spel ba dang / /ze 'bru mtshon byed srub rnams ser pos 'gengs/ /dam can snam bu'i gzhi ni dmar skya la/ /ser pos za 'og ri mo gang mdzes bri/ /de steng me tog sngo ljang gang legs bkod/ /dur khrod gzhi nag phyogs mtshams chu yis bcad/ /chu ni sngo skya chu ris ci mdzes bya/ /dur khrod brgyad du phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /so so'i kha dog mthun pa'i tshon spung bya/ /grub thob brgyad la tshon mdog gang byung gi /tshon spungs bkod na shin tu legs par mngon/ /shing me mchod rten ro dang keng rus dang / /shar du sprin ser lho sngo nub dkar po/ /byang ser byang shar dkar la shar lho dmar/ /lho nub nub byang sngon po'i sprin bri 'o/ /chos 'byung mtshon byed mtha' la dmar skyas bcad/ /rdo ra lcags nag rdo rje dkar pos bri/ /me ris sna tshogs phyag len ltar bris la/ /bcad rnams ci mdzes yid 'ongs ldan par mdzod/ /bri ba rdzogs nas tshon gyi lhag ma dang / /ye thig srad bur bcas pa legs bsdus te/ /bla mas puṣpe la sogs mchod pa lnga/ /dbus nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang badzra muḥ/zhes brjod ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa/ /rang la thim zhes ci bder gnas pas so/ /de nas nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye shes kyi thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ gnyis pa mtshan ma dgod pa ni/ ka to ra sogs phur bu rnams shong tsam gyi snod nas kyis bkang pa la gtso phur dang /

khro bo bcu/ khra thabs/ sgo ma bzhi ste bco lnga go rim dbus su/ dam can bcu gnyis/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad de phur pa bzhi bcu po mtha' la bkod nas gu gul gyis bdugs la/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharmā dha tu badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /tshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ e spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng waṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /dbus su keṃ rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ /dzaḥpā padma maṇḍa la/ mahā surya maṇḍa la/ a tsant+ra maṇḍa la/ mahā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wi dzaḥ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bab pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus/ 'od du zhu nas rang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnan hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐/ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/

/nas/ ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /kyi bar dang / rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched/ skra nyis khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med par gtams par gyur/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /bhruṃ bi mā na/ mā surya hūm̐/ dzñā na satwa kriṣṇa shu ka pañtsa badzra hūm̐/ kī la ya brjod/ oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ bhyoḥ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas mkhyud pas bzhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur par bsam la/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams/ /'khor ba rdo rjer sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing / 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badzra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa rang la bstim/ sangs rgyas kun gyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs so/ /yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang lha rigs lnga mdun du spyan drangs nas dbang bskur gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas sogs brjod pas ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud de khro bo rigs lngas dbur brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri a/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ kha 'phangs 'di rnams sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gang rung blta'o/ /de nas phur ba rnams yungs kar gyis brabs nas/ e spha ra ṇa phaṭ dang /

'khyil pas bsang pa nas/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnan rakṣa rakṣa/ yungs kar dang rakta gtor/ gu gul gyis bdugs la/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ sogs brjod/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /nas/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /kyi bar dang / oṃ dipta tsakra/ sogs/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sogs nas/ g.yon nas 'khyud pas bar dang / oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang smig bu'i mgo /zhes sogs brjod pa dang mnyam du phur pa rnams lha de dang de'i ngo bor krong gis bskyed/ sgo ma'i bar sngags brjod pa dang / gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ yo gi shwa ri aṣṭa biṃ sha ti hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma shrī ghraṃ karma ka ra ma ra se na pra mardha ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /bka' yi srung ma dam can bcu gnyis sogs/ /rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dbang gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pas sogs kyis dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gnas rnams su/ pā padma maṇḍa la/ nas/ ma traṃ dza'i bar brjod pas gdan rnams mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ de nas phur gdan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang / 'khor lo'i rtsibs sgo ma dam can gyi snam bu'i steng rnams su bzhag slob dpon gyis gtso phur lag tu thogs nas gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid nas/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa yang /

/dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /lha chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dipta tsakra badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ rigs 'gre sbyar la/ steng nas rang byungྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/ /sprul pa phag dang rmig bu'i mgo /dbang dangྎ tshangs paྎ dges shingྎ oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭ/ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ shar nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ rnam rgyal rdo rje sgeg mor bcas/ /sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbang dangྎ dri zaྎ dges shingྎ oṃ badzra kro dha sogs rang rang gi sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ zhes pa thams cad la sbyar ro/ /me nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mor bcas/ /sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo /dbang dangྎ me lhaྎ dges shingྎ oṃ badzra sogs so/ /lho nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ gshin rje rdo rje dur khrod bcas/ /sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /dbang dangྎ gshin rjeྎ dges shingྎ sngags brjod/ lho nubྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ mi g.yo rdo rje gtun khung bcas/ /sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /dbang dangྎ srin poྎ dges shingྎ sngags brjod/ nub nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ rta mgrin rdo rje gtum mor bcas/ /sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo /dbang dangྎ chu lhaྎ dges shingྎ sngags brjod/ rlung nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyam bcas/ /sprul pa ce spyang khra yi mgo /dbang dangྎ rlung lhaྎ dges shingྎ sngags brjod/ byang nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ 'khyil pa rdo rje sgra mdzad bcas/ /sprul pa seṅge pha waṃ mgo /dbangྎ gnod sbyinྎ dges shingྎ sngags brjod/ byang sharྎ sangs rgyasྎ chos dbyingsྎ khams gsum rdo rje gsod mar bcas/ /sprul pa dred dang sbre mong mgo /dbang dangྎ bgegs bdagྎ dges shingྎ sngags brjod/ 'og nasྎ sangs rgyasྎ

chos dbyingsྎ stobs chen rdo rje rig byed bcas/ /sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo /dbang dangྎ sa bdagྎ dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kro dha mahā ba la hūm̐/ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭ/ badzra sa mā ya tiṣṭhantu/ shar nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /'gugs byed chen mo pu shud mgo /shar sgo'i nyi steng mi ro'i steng / /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ badzra sa mā ya tiṣṭhantu/ de bzhin du rigs bsgres te/ lho nasྎ 'ching byed chen mo bya rog mgo /lho sgorྎ dges shingྎ bhai ra bi sogs brjod/ nub nasྎ sdom byed chen mo srin bya'i mgo /nub sgorྎ dges shingྎ a mṛ ta/ sogs brjod/ byang nasྎ brnyas byed chen mo khra yi mgo /byang sgorྎ dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra ma ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ badzra sa mā ya tiṣṭhantu/ khor yug gi dam can dbang phyug ma'i phur bu rnams la gong gi rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /sogs kyi rjes su/ dam tshig dgongs shing rang rang gdan la bzhugs/ /gong gi sngags kyi mjug tu/ a sa na tiṣṭhantu/ zhes pa bkod/ gnyis pa rgyan dgram pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mda' dar bcu/ steng dang logs su tshon skud kyi dra ba/ gzhan yang bla bre/ yol ba/ 'phan gdugs sogs kyis mdzes par bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i nang grwa bzhir 'byor na bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa bzhi'i steng du thod pa'am nya phyis kyi steng du bdud rtsi blugs pa yang bshams shing / ma 'byor na bum thod kyi gzugs bris pas kyang rung ngo / /mda' dra ni/ mda' ring thung med pa bcu rdza la sogs pa'i gdan la btsugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la 'khor lo'i rtse nas rkyang thig 'then pa'i rtags byas par snyom par bzhag tshon skud sna lngas mda' gcig gi ltong nas dkris/ yang de'i 'khris kyi mda'i rtsa ba nas bskor la/ de'i 'khris kyi ltong la bskor ba'i steng /

gong gi lan gnang dus byas nas 'khor ba dang / mda' gnyis bar du chos 'byung mgo sprod dang / mda' re re'i thad du nam mkha' 'dra ba yong / de nas steng du drag po rgya mdud e khram nyer gcig bri ste/ de yang mda' gcig gi ltong nas mda' gsum bar du bzhag la bzhi pa'i ltong la dkris/ de bzhin gsum gsum bzhag nas skud pa 'then te/ dkri thengs lnga pa la thog ma'i ltong la slebs yong / de nas 'khris kyi mda' la 'phar te de'i ltong la dkris/ yang gong bzhin mda' gsum gsum bzhag la skud pa 'then te/ dkri thengs lnga la 'khor yong / drag po rgya mdud ni 'dzom rnams yin la/ e khram nyer gcig ni chos 'byung rtsa nang bstan bcu dang phyir bstan bcu ste nyi shu/ dbus su chos 'byung bri cha la yongs bas nyer gcig tshon skud la nyi shu yong ngo / /de nas ltong bcu po thams cad la bskor zhing dkris tshar ba dang / mda' gang rung gi ltong nas mar phyed tsam dkris nas/ logs kyi chos 'byung mgo sprod mtshams kyi thad nas mda' re la dkris shing bskor te 'khor ba dang / gong du dkris pa'i phyed man la dkris/ rtsa bar slebs pa dang mda' thams cad kyi rtsa ba bskor/ de nas mda' rnams la 'byor na khro bo bcu'i zhal mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gdags/ ma 'byor na dar kha re gdags pas kyang chog gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa la bzhi ste/ dkyil chog las/ byin gyis brlab la tho gzugs dang / /bum pa 'god dang lhag chad bkang / /gsol ba gdab pa'i bya ba 'o/ /zhes pa las dang po tho 'dzugs pa ni/ phyag len la dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhi'i shar du yul 'khor bsrung / lhor 'phags skyes po/ nub tu mig mi bzang / byang du rnam thos sras rnams kyi tsa ka li'i bris sku dgram/ stegs ji ltar rigs par gtor ma zlum gtor gcig gi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham pa shar gyi sku'i drung du khyer la/

dpon slob ji ltar rigs pa langs nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sku la kha phyogs te/ thog mar shar gyi mchod gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra a ha ra'i dus rol mo byed/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ sku la dmigs nas/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shuddha3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du dhṛ las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung ljang gu/ phyag g.yas kyis pi waṃ sgreng shing / dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas grong khyer yul 'khor srung nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ de nas rnga sil dang bcas 'dur gdangs bya zhing / dri za dag gi bdag po rgyal/ /shar gyi phyogs rnams skyong byed pa/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung / /yul 'khor srung nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā rā dza dhṛṣṭa raṣṭa sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim par bsam mo/ /sngags kyi bar la rol mo chems brdungs dang / gong 'og gnyis su gsum brdung lan bcas byed/ de bzhin kha gsal med pa'i tshigs bcad rnams la gdangs dang bstun gsum brdungs dang / sngags rnams la chems brdung shes par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod rdzas 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces dang / rol mo'i bar la/ oṃ mahā rā dza dhṛṣṭa raṣṭa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ/ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/

ghandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda pra titstsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ rol mo bzhag la/ gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ oṃ mahā rā dza dhṛṣṭa raṣṭa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thata khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba lyā swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul la rnga brdungs shing / shar phyogs na ni gnas bsrung po/ /'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan/ /shar phyogs dag ni skyong byed pa/ /rdzu 'phrul che la stobs kyang che/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /de nas rol mo bzhag la/ na mo mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ rgyal po chen po gnas srung po 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /bsngo'o/ /sngon gyi thugs dam la mnos te/ bdag cag gis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas/ phyi'i dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / phyi mtshams bsrung zhing dngos grub ma lus pa bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzad du gsol/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod cing rtag par bzhugs nas 'phrin las sgrub par bsam/ de nas gong bzhin gyi mchod gtor lhor khyer nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ tiṣṭha badzra'i bar gyi rigs 'gre sbyar te/ gzhan rnams 'dra ba las bskyed chog ni/ swa bha wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri steng du baṃ las rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po sngon po/ g.yas ral gri g.yon gdan la bsten pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ sogs dang / grong khyer 'phags skyes po nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa/ sogs/ grul bum dag giྎ lho yiྎ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ /'phags pa skyes nas spyan 'dren mchod pa gtor sngags rnams kyi gong 'og 'dra/

bi ru dhra ga'o/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /'jig rtenྎ lho phyogsྎ rdzu 'phrulྎ mchod sbyinྎ rnal 'byorྎ bar chadྎ dngos grubྎ 'phrin bcol dus/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa sogs so/ /mchod gtor nub tu khyer la gzhan gong 'og thams cad 'dra ba la/ khyad par ni bskyed chog skabs/ paṃ las rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dmar po/ g.yas sbrul zhags/ g.yon mchod rten 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ sogs so/ /grong khyer sna tshogs gzugs nas rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa/ sogs/ klu rnams kyi niྎ nub kyi phyogsྎ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang / /sna tshogs gzugs nasྎ sngags rnams gong 'og 'dra/ bi ru pakṣa pa ces so/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /'jig rtenྎ nub kyiྎ rdzu 'phrulྎ mchod sbyinྎ rnal 'byorྎ bar chadྎ dngos grubྎ 'phrin bcol dus/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang 'khor dang / sogs so/ /mchod gtor byang du khyer la/ gzhan thams cad 'dra/ bskyed chog la/ bai las rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu ser po g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug tho/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ sogs nas/ grong khyer lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu 'khor dang bcas pa/ sogs dang / gnod sbyin dag giྎ byang giྎ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu/ /lcang lo can nasྎ sngags rnams gong 'og 'dra ba las/ bai shrā ma ṇa/ zhes sogs so/ /byang phyogs nas ni lus ngan po/ /'jig rtenྎ byang giྎ rdzu 'phrulྎ mchod sbyinྎ rnal 'byorྎ bar chadྎ dngos grubྎ 'phrin bcol dus/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo la sogs pa'o/ /dam sri mnan pa mi dgos pa bzhin mi mdzad/ gnyis pa bum pa dgod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa/

mchod g.yog pas las bum dang / spos thogs nas sna drangs/ gzhan yang rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum gyi rjes ma la/ gtso bo dang khro bcu rnams la bum pa 'bul ba'i stengs ka byas la/ lha re la phul ba dang bstun rang gi spyi bor gtugs pa re byed/ skor ba'i ring la/ kī la ya bzla/ bum pa 'jog khar shar du gnas pas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar mda' dra'i bar gang 'os su bum gdan steng du bzhag las bum slob dpon gyis bzung mchod g.yog pas spos sogs gong bzhin gyi bskor ba gcig byas/ 'khyil sngags brjod bzhin pas lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas la shar du gnas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ ces brjod la mda' dra'i bar byang shar gyi gang bder bum gdan steng du bzhag dkyil chog las/ rang sngags kyis phyogs mtshams su 'bul lo gsungs pa bzhin/ kī la ya la/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ /badzra shes rab yum du brjod/ /kī li dang po khro bo bcu/ /kī li gnyis pa khro mo bcu/ /zhes pa de la sogs pa'i sgo nas gtso 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags yin pas bum pa 'bul ba/ sbyin sreg gi grangs 'dzin pa/ bsnyen pa sogs kī la ya 'ba' zhig mdzad pa 'di ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad tshang ba la dgongs shing don la yang gnas pas so/ /gsum pa lhag chad kha bskong ba ni/ spos sna rol mo dang bcas bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor zhing yig brgya bzla/ shar phyogs su 'greng ste rol mo bzhag la/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang /

sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa dang / khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor bri ba la skyon du gyur pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing / lhag chad kha bskong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa gsol ba gdab pa'i bya ba ni/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil dang bstun shlau ka dang po la bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs dang / gnyis pa nas 'dur gdangs byed cing / hūm̐/ chos dbyings dag pa'i ngo bo las/ /sku gnyis rnam par byung nas ni/ /sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyis med kyang ni/ /bdag gis slob ma dbang bskur phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la lnga ste/ dkyil chog las/ ting 'dzin bsgom la lha bskyed dang / /mchod tshogs gtor ma lhag chad bskangs/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa lha bskyed pa'i thog ma mchod pa bsham pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dri bzang gi chus byugs la/ mchod gtor rnams sta gon las mi nyung bar lag len bzhin bshams la/ phyag len mi gsal ba cung zad brjod na/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi mtha' la snum byugs pa dang / gdugs bskor gyi rtsa ba ras bal gyis sdom pa ni bse mo sogs sems can mi 'byung ba'i ched lags/ dri bzang gi chus mi byug spyi mchod gdugs bskor nang / dkyil 'khor gyi me ri'i phyi la sta gon bzhin la/ sgos mchod ni sta gon bzhin bcu drug sgor mor spyi mchod nang ngam bar mtshams su bshams/ ma 'byor na phyogs bzhir spos/ mar me/ zhal zas re mdzad/ slob dpon grogs dang bcas pa gral la 'khod/

sngon 'gro gtor ma dang mchod pa byin dbab/ rnga byin rlabs nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su babs pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li/ sogs dang / dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /sogs dang / bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi bzlas pa dang / rig 'dzin bskul ba yan sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin nyams su blangs pas/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis par gyur/ zhes brjod/ sgrub mchod lta bu dpon slob mang po ma yin par/ slob dpon kho nas bsdus pa nyams su len na/ sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar nyams su blangs la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ ces brjod/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa mdzad na bzlas pa bsdus te/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma mdzad rjes/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba mdzad nas/ rig 'dzin bskul la bzhengs nas dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du gnang / sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gang mdzad na'ang / 'khor ba phur bu'i dus sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg pa yang spyan drangs la/ dgug gzhug gi tshe dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa man la mi dgos so/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i gong du mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa mdzad/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni sgrub thabs khongs su 'du/ gsum pa tshogs ni rjes su 'byung / bzhi pa phyi rol gtor ma ni/ rig 'dzin bskul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du zlum gtor gcig dang / de'i g.yas su chu gnyis me tog dang gsum/ g.yon phyogs spos/ mar me dri dang gsum rgyab tu zhal zas/ mdun du nang mchod cung zad gcig rnams bshams/

dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ 'khyil pas bsang / swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / dril bu gsil zhing / phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong srin po yi dwags klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi/ padma kā ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ int+ra ye/ agna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ta ye/ wa ru ṇā ya/ wa ya be/ ku be rā ya/ i shwa rā ya/ urdhaṃ brahma/ sūrya gra ha a ti pa tā ye/ tsant+ra nakṣa tra/ a dhi pa ta ye/ i to pri th-i wi bhyaḥ u su ra bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam la bzhag yang sngar gyi sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes la/ gṛhṇa daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃྎ puṣpaṃྎ dhu paṃྎ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ swāhās mchod/ de nas tshigs bcad re la dril gsil bya zhing / dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi sogs 'gre/ shar lho gdon gyi sogs 'gre/ mchod cing sogs 'gre/ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal poྎ

lho phyogsྎ mchod cingྎ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'iྎ lho nubྎ mchod cingྎ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal poྎ nub phyogsྎ mchod cingྎ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal poྎ nub byangྎ mchod cingྎ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal poྎ byang phyogsྎ mchod cingྎ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal poྎ byang sharྎ mchod cingྎ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cingྎ 'og gi klu de sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ gong gi sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thata khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba liṃ di swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul te dril gsil dang bcas pas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /rgyu de de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/

/rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skyes/ /de nas ji ltar rigs pas rnga brdungs shing dpon slob byin gyis dril gsil 'dur gdangs dang bcas pas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing / /zhing dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces dang / rol mo gsum brdeg lan bcas grub mtshams dril bu gsil zhing rdo rje thugs khar bzung la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang /

'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs pa bgyid na/ slob ma yod na 'di dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma sa lha sogs kyi gang dgos su/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/ sogs skabs dang sbyar nas brjod rjes/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad zhi ba dang / dngos grub bsgrub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod/ ces brjod pa'i bar la mchod g.yog pas zhal zas nas/ puṣpe'i bar rim pas bcug nas bsdus te gtor ma'i nang du blug chu gnyis gcig tu bsgril/ me tog sogs kyi snod kha phub bo/ /dpon slob rnams kyis yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs shlau ka gcig brjod/ mchod g.yog pas gong du bsgril ba'i mchod yon gtor ma la cung zad blugs nas mtha' la bskor te lam phyogs la gtor/ dpon slob rnams kyis mtheb srin sbyar ba'i se gol gtogs la badzra muḥ phyogs skyong rnams sgrub khang gi phyogs bcur bzhugs nas bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod/ ces dang / nang mchod nas slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas blangs nas slob dpon rang nyid dang / mchod g.yog pa'i gnas gsum du reg pa'i rnam pa tsam byas la bsrung ba'i mos pa byas/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ slob dpon sogs kyis rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil/ kī la ya brjod/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ lnga pa lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du sleb rim gyis zhwa phud rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu rgyun dkrol dang / yig brgya brjod cing / dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor/ mi shong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas bskor bar bsam/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'greng ste/ ma 'byor ba dang / sogs gong gi lhag chad kha bskangs pa bzhin la/ khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor bri ba la zhes pa'i tshab tu/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la zhes pa brjes tsam ma gtogs 'dra/
