sgrub mchod zhag sbrel na/ nub phyi ma rnams la/ chos dbyings dag pa'i ngo bo las/ /sogs gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bum skyed byas la/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ dkyil chog las/ dbang bskur la yang bdag 'jug dang / /slob ma dbang bskur rnam gnyis so/ /zhes pa ste/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad 'dus byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gis dbang thob pa'i slob dpon du mos la/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa rnams gtso bos gsungs par bsam/ rjes zlos dgos pa rnams rang gis byed par bsam nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blang ste/ de'ang dkyil chog las sdom tshig gsungs pa rnams rim pas sbyar zhing kha skong cung zad dang bcas brjod na/ 'jug dang dngos gzhi dbang bskur gnyis/ /dang po 'jug la'ang phyi nang gnyis/ /phyi la spro dri bden pa brjod/ /chas zhugs la yang gdong bcing dang / /me tog 'phreng gtad phyi nang gi /bar chad bsrungs dang nang sems bskyed/ /maṇḍal gsol gdab phyi 'jug go /zhes pa ste/ thog mar las bum mam rnam rgyal nas chu cung zad 'thung ste/ khrus byas par bsam la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ spro ba dri ba ni/ bu khyod tshur shog ci la dga'/ /'dod don gang yin khyod kyis smros/ /zhes gsungs par bsam/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la/ /bdag ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rab tu dga' bas 'tshal lags so/ /zhes rang gis lan btab/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ dril bu gsil zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor 'dir/

/gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum/ chas su zhugs pa la gdong bcing ba ni/ oṃ tsakṣu bandha wa ra ma na ya hūm̐ gis gdong bcing bar bsam/ me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad pa ni/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog 'phreng ba lag tu gnang bar bsam/ phyi'i bar chad bsrung ba ni/ ku shas las bum gyi chu rang la gtor nas/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi sogs sgo ma bzhi'i sngags dang / a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil sngags brjod/ nang gi bar chad bsrung ba ni/ nang mchod nas lce thog tu bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ nang gi sems bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da ya mi zhes dang / rdo rje snying khar reg la/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ zhes brjod/ maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ dang po 'di dang gtang rag gi tha ma gnyis la maṇḍal bdun ma rgyas pa brjod/ ye shes dbab pa sogs gzhan rnams la/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyis 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /slob dpon gyis kyang bdag gzhug gsol/ /lan gsum brjod pa ste phyi 'jug go /gnyis pa nang 'jug gi sdom ni/ nang la gsol phyag dam bsgrags dang / /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sdom pa legs par bzung byas nas/ /ye shes dbab pa dam bzhag dang / /maṇḍal gsol gdab dngos rnams so/ /snang ba dri dang me tog dor/ /mig dbye me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang / /dkyil 'khor blta bar rab bskul nas/ /bstan pa la yang mtshan nyid dang /

/rten dang brten pa'i rnam dag go /zhes pa las/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo dril 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ḥ zhes brjod cing / bla ma'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khrid par bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la bla mas gsungs par bsam zhing dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor byas nas/ shar sgor gnas pas lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / dam tshig bsgrags pa la bdag 'jug mi mdzad/ sdom pa bzung ba la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu/ dkon mchog gsum sogs bsam la/ thun mong ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor sngags bdag he ru ka /'khor lo bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de rnams la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi dngos po ni/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni/ /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /bde gshegs spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /dus gsum sdig pa bgyis pa rnams/ /khyod la ma lus so sor bshag /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom nyan thos sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ /de la rjes su yi rang bgyi/

/sems can ma lus srid par lhung / /'gro rnams kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis dus 'di nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa 'dzin snyam pas/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ongs pa la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog sdom par ni/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrubs nas kyang / /sems can 'khor bar bying ba rnams/ /byang chub gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi'i dang por phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ rigs kyi bu mchog tshur nyon cig /deng khyod bde gshegs 'khor bcas kyi/ /nang du khyod nyid zhugs pa na/ /slob dpon lung bstan ngas kyang ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /ye shes khyod la bskyed par bya/ /rnal 'byor bu mchog khyod kyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur/

/dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras par gyur na ni/ /dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar 'gro /zhes dang / gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag bzhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /gsum pa gnyis ka 'am mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum chu 'am nang mchod nas lcer bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta ha na ha na u ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ bzhi pa bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ deng nas brtsams te thams cad du/ /rdo rje gzhon nu nga yin gyi/ /nga yis smras pa bu yis bgyis/ /nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig /nga la brnyas pa byas na ni/ /khyod ni sdug bsngal ma bral bar/ /tshe yi 'du byed byas nas ni/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung / /zhes so/ /maṇḍal ni/ maṇḍal gling bzhi sogs kyi mjug tu/ phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes so/ /gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa dngos ni/ rang skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/

g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me phung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu sgril zhing dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa'i 'og tu/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdungs pa lta bu 'chang zung thur du bstan zhing / mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang gu drag cing bzod par dka' ba re re/ sum mdor raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang lte ba la laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par waṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su has mtshan pa/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung de g.yos/ rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar/ long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug khyug song / sum mdor gzhi gnas kyi me dang khrug chil te 'dres pas drag tu 'bar bas snying kha'i sa sros/ des mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas spyi bo'i rlung g.yos/ thur du bus pas mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma snying kha'i sa la thim pas bde ba dang / lte ba'i me 'bar bas drod skyes nas snying khar bde drod 'dzom pa la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs kha nas rdo rje gnod sbyin ma mdog dkar mo pu shud kyi mgo can lcags kyu dang phur pa thogs pa mang po spros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ rang gi rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis thur du mnan nas lus bar snang du 'dar yed yed gnas pa'i spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par gyur/ hūm̐ a ha dzhai/ lan gsum brjod nas rol mo rnams drag tu byas te/ tiṣṭha mahā kro dha a bhe sha ya a bhe sha ya stambha ya stambha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sogs brjod/ rol mo bzhag tiṣṭha badzra sogs brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram/ snang ba dri ba ni/ gtso bo bla mas kha dog dri ba mdzad par bsam ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha'i kha dog brtags la/ dkar ser dmar nag ljang gu sna tshogs rnams mthong na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las sna tshogs rnams 'grub bo snyam du dran par bya'o/ /me tog dor ba ni/ oṃ pra titstsha badzra hoḥsngar gyi me tog gtso bo'i dbur phul bar bsam/ mig dbye ba ni/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /mig gi ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /khyod kyi mi shes dri ma bsal/ /oṃ badzra pra be shā ya phaṭ/ ces brjod la mig dar dbye bar bsam/ me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang ni/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /me tog 'phreng bas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes me tog 'phreng ba phul la/ de mgo bor bzhag cing dbang bskur bar bsam/ de ltar na khyod kyi mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas ye shes kyi mig thob ste thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul ba ni/ he badzra pā shye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /shes rab rnam gsum rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni thugs kyi rigs su skye/

/bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlab/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /'gro ba rigs drug thams cad la/ /bu bzhin snying rje kun la bskyed/ /gsang ba'i chos la dad par gyis/ /zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bstan pas ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mthong bar mos pa byed pa'am/ rten dang brten pa'i rnam dag ni/ gzhal yas gru bzhir gyur pa ni/ /tshad med bzhi rnams rnam par dag /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /rta babs yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa/ /nyon mongs che chung rnam dag rtags/ /ka ba brgyad kyis dbus brgyan pa/ /'phags lam brgyad po rnam dag rtags/ /rin chen pha gu la sogs brgyan/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags/ /'dod pa'i lha mos brgyan pa ni/ /gzugs sgra dri ro rnam dag rtags/ /sgo bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi rnams ni/ /rnam rtog bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags/ /zur bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi rnams ni/ /phyi yi bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags/ /zhing gi bla bres brgyan pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rtags/ /rdo rje rwa bas bskor ba ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags/ /me 'od 'bar bas bskor ba ni/ /bgegs la sogs pas mi tshugs rtags/ /bum pa rnams kyis brgyan pa ni/ /byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i rtags/ /dpag bsam shing gis brgyan pa ni/ /thugs rje yongs la khyab pa'i rtags/ /zhes brjod pas rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam dag go /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa 'o/ /khro bo chen po rnam rgyal ni/ /ngag 'khyal rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni/ /brdzun du smra ba rnam par dag /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /srog gcod rnam par dag las byung /

/khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon/ /log par blta ba rnam par dag /khro bo chen po rta mgrin ni/ /phra ma rnam par dag pa 'o/ /khro chen gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /ma byin len pa rnam par dag /khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /tshig rtsub rnam par dag pa 'o/ /khro chen khams gsum rnam rgyal ni/ /gnod sems rnam par dag pa 'o/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /brnab sems rnam par dag pa 'o/ /khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ /'dod log rnam par dag pa 'o/ /de rnams kun gyi yum rnams ni/ /rnam par dag pa'i yum rnams so/ /shar sgo pu shud mgo can ni/ /snying rje rnam par dag pa 'o/ /lho sgor bya rog mgo can ni/ /byams pa rnam par dag pa 'o/ /nub sgor srin bya'i mgo can ni/ /dga' ba rnam par dag pa 'o/ /byang sgor khra yi mgo can ni/ /btang snyoms rnam par dag pa 'o/ /zhes brten pa lha'i rnam dag go /de ltar na 'jug pa rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pas lam lnga las tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan pa byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang la'ang bum dbang gsang dbang dang / /shes rab ye shes bzhi pa 'o/ /dang po bum dbang la yang gnyis/ /slob ma slob dpon rnam gnyis so/ /slob ma'i sngon 'gro'i maṇḍal dang / /gsol gdab byur bsal dngos la yang / /rigs lnga bdag po'i dbang rnams so/ /zhes pa ltar sngon 'gro slob ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur rnams/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang stsol cig /ces lan gsum/ byur bsal ba ni/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du seṅge'i khri padma nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la/

rang nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhes pa'i bar ye shes dbab pa bzhin las/ de'i steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ kī la ya/ zhes brjod cing rol mo drag tu brdung ngo / /dngos gzhi rig pa'i dbang lnga ni rang dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis la ku sha'i rtsa bas las bum gyi chu gtor zhing / a mri tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa 'di rnams mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo kho na yin/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra u da pha la ya/ biṣpu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang / dril bu gsil zhing / mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje'i thugs ni bla na med/ /skye med spros bral ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod cing bstod de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma dang / dbang lha rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams par bsam la/ rang gis rnam rgyal bum pa bteg ste/ 'khril pa'i mchod chen gyi gdangs dang bcas pas/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /byang chub sems rab chus gang ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis/ /bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra akṣo bhyeḥ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapda āḥhūm̐/ u da pha la biṣpu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang rol mo bya/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de bzhin du rigs pa'i dbang gzhan rnams kyi ngag 'don phal cher mi bskyod pa dang 'dra zhing mi 'dra ba'i khyad par brjod na rin 'byung la/ rang dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang /

raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ swā las rin po che swās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sogs dang / gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu/ sogs/ ye shes spyan 'dren la/ thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par sogs dril gsil gyi bar bya/ lta ba ngan pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen rgyal po yon tan gtso/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen 'byung ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ dbu rgyan lag tu thogs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis rgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsngags pa yi/ /rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa swa/ badzra ra ga ta badzra sha li hoḥ zhes brjod cing dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs spyi bor bcings la/ rnam rgyal bum chu ku shas mgo bor gtor zhing / oṃ badzri bha wa sogs nas/ mi bskyod pa'i tshab tu/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ratna sambha wa badzra a ha ra li sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /'od dpag med la/ rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje bsang sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las padma as mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sogs dang / 'od dpag med kyi rnam par nas/ dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje'i gsung ni dpag med pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung mchog dpal/

/rdo rje'i gsung ni kun 'byung ba/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /don ni byang chub sems yin pas/ /gnyis med don gyi ngo bo nyid/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje lag pa g.yas pas gsor zhing bzung / bum chu gtor zhing dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ a mṛ ta bhā wa hrīḥ sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /don yod grub pa la/ dbang rdzas dril bu bsang sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ gdan bskyed hā las ral gri hās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sogs dang / don yod grub pa'i rnam par nas/ dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje las rab kun gyi gtso/ /sems can kun gyi don grub pa/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /las kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ 'di ni shes rab kun gyi dngos/ /byang chub bsgom phyir rang bzhin te/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /khyod la de ring 'dis dbang bskur/ /oṃ badzra gaṇḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / dril bu lag pa g.yon pas gsil bum chu gtor dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ a mo gha siddhi/ sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad la rang dang dbang rdzas rdor dril bsang sbyangs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ gdan bskyed/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sogs dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par/ dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje'i sku ni dga' chen po/ /thams cad zhi ba'i mchog nyid gsal/ /rang gi ngang gi 'od gsal mchog /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ rdor dril lag pa gnyis kas bzung zhing dkrol la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu bsngags pa gsang ba'i ming / /rang gi gsang mtshan brjod de/ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya bas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra satwa satwaṃ badzra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bum chu gtor dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ bai ro tsa ni sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mu dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /bdag po'i dbang la/ rang nyid bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rang nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i bar dang / de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ rang la bstim sogs gong byur bsal ba bzhin brjod/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang /

thod pa a las ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ shes rab padma'i snod yin te/ /thabs mchog rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag mtshan 'dis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradzñā u pa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje lag pa g.yas dang / thod pa g.yon du gnang bar bsam pa thugs kar bsnol lo/ /de ltar na dbang rnam pa drug gi sgo nas kun gzhi'i dri ma sel zhing / ma rig pa nyon mongs pa drug bsal nas rig pa rigs drug gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob dpon dbang la maṇḍal dang / /gsol btab dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ /brtan byed bum chus dbang bskur zhing / /rigs bdag rgyas gdab rab gnas bya/ /bzlas lung rigs lnga'i sprul bshad dang / /dung sbyin rtogs pa bskyed rnams so/ /zhes pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /bdag gis rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ /de ring bdag la rjes gnang stsol/ /lan gsum/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni rang gi lag gi rdor dril/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dril bu a las snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdor dril lag pa g.yas g.yon du gnang par bsam zhing / rang rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/

thabs mchog ye shes rdo rje dang / /shes rab chos kyi dril bu zung / /phyag rgya chen pos byin brlabs te/ /dam tshig gsum po rab tu brtan/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ru/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnan bandha hūm̐ phaṭ/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dril bu gsil la rdo rje gsor zhing thugs ka dang / dril bu dku g.yon du brten la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ mahā badzra hūm̐/ a/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra gaṇḍe āḥ de nas rdor dril snying khar bsnol la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /de ltar rdo rje gtad pas ni sems thabs bde ba'i ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa ni rdo rje thugs ka'i dam tshig dril bu gtad pas ni ngag gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su byin gyis rlob par byed pa ni dril bu gsung gi dam tshig go /rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi skur gsal ba phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig ste dam tshig gsum po stabs gcig tu thob ste/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes nyams su myong bas/ don gyis bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob par bsam/

dbang de brtan byed bum pas dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab la/ rab gnas te ku shas rnam rgyal bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa he ru kas gtso mdzad pa'i khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa la lha thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa yin no/ /oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing nas 'bras gang rung spyi bor gtor/ oṃ badzra dha ra a hā ra sogs rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ bzlas lung ni bdag 'jug la mi mdzad/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad la/ rigs lnga'i nga rgyal rim pa bzhin byed cing / tshig dang bstun phyag rgya bcas la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de bzhin du tshig gong ma gsum 'dra ba las/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshab tu/ rdo rje'i 'khor loྎ rin chen 'khor loྎ padma'iྎ ral gri'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang / dung 'bud pa'i tshul bya zhing / tshig gong ma gsum 'dra ba las/ khyod kyis chos kyi dung bus shig de ltar na khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ ral gri'i 'khor lo rnams bskor la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig de ltar na khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bris bsgrub dbang bskur 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad la dbang bas slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin no/

/rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhes sam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes skabs thob dang sbyar la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing / lam lnga las sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus kyi dri ma dag ste sprul sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang maṇḍal dang / /gsol gdab rig ma slob dpon phul/ /gdong bcing 'bru gsum brjod byas la/ /bdud rtsi gtor zhing bsrung ba dang / /slob dpon mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas/ /dbab cing byang sems lce la bzhag /gsal stong bsgom la nga rgyal gzung / /gdong phye rtogs bskyed lung bstan dang / /dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod rim bzhin bya/ /zhes te/ gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang gsum dag pa'i dbang chog 'di/ /de ring bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /lan gsum/ rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa phyag rgyar phul bar bsam la/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /don chen zab mos nyon mongs 'joms/ /de ring bdag la dbab par zhu/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gdong bcing bar bsam la/ bdud rtsi rang la gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas bsrung bar bya/ slob dpon gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭ dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kunda ltar dkar ba bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal rnam 'joms te/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni dam pas na/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya/ /zhes gnang bar bsam la/ nang mchod nas lce thog tu bzhag ste/ a ho mahā su kha/ zhes brjod cing myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag cing / nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bdag ni bsod nams skal ba che/ /yon tan kun gyis bdag brgyan te/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bdag nyid do/ /'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing / lam lnga las mthong lam sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des ngag gi dri ma dag ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /lung bstan ni/ lag g.yas rdor dril dang / lag g.yon chos gos kyi grwa gnyis seṅge'i rna ba ltar byas la/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ sa 'og sa steng / sa bla rnams su oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa mā ya satwaṃ bhurbhu wa swā/ 'di ltar ngas lung bstan pa ltar/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad pa 'di ni sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/

/ngo bo nyid du khyod gyur to/ /khams gsum bdag por khyod gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpar khyod gyur to/ /bdud dang mu stegs thams cad las/ /rgyal bar gyur pa khyod nyid do/ /grong khyer la yang grong khyer du/ /rnal 'byor snod ldan khyod gzhug go /sangs rgyas grub pa'i rgyu 'di yin/ /'di la the tshom ma byed cig /gzings bstod pa ni/ da khyed rnams srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing myur du sangs rgya bar 'gyur bas/ rang dman pa'i blo yongs su spongs la dga' ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig gsum pa shes rab ye shes la/ maṇḍal gsol gdab gdong bcing bsrung / /rig ma gtad cing dri ba dang / /dris lan padma'i che ba brjod/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs dga' bzhi bskyed/ /gdong g.yogs phye zhing rtogs bskyed do/ /zhes te/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ji ltar mkhyen cing thugs chud pa/ /de ltar rjes su bdag dad na/ /de ring bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcings par bsam/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas bsrung / rig ma gtad pa ni/ bla mas rang la phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnang bar bsam la/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /shes rab 'di la brten nas bsgrubs/ /rigs kyi bu mchog khyod kyis kyang / /shes rab spang du mi rung ste/ /ye shes skye ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /khyod kyis 'dod chags ma spongs shig /rig mas dri ba ni/ bu khyod tshur shog rdo rje can/ /dri chen dri chu za nus sam/ /rakta ga bur bsten nus sam/ /bud med dang bas bsten nus sam/ /padmar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig snod ldan ngang tshul can/ /rang gis dris lan gdab pa ni/ shes rab dag pas bdag bsten to/ /dri chen la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/

/rtag tu dad pas bsten par bgyi/ /padmar bdag ni 'o bgyid do/ /rig mas bha ga bstan te/ padma'i che ba brjod pa ni/ rmad byung nga yi padma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'di las byung / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyang / /rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral lo/ /padma 'di ni chos dbyings yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las byung / /sems can thams cad 'di ru grol/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /padma zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /padma'i nang gi nam mkha' zhes/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin gnas/ /lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ze 'bru'i dbus nas byung ba yi/ /de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po 'o/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ rig ma'i phyag g.yon pa rang gi lag par gnang bar bsam la/ shes rab dam pa 'di yis ni/ /khyod kyi ye shes skyed byed pa/ /'di dang khyod kyi rtag tu spangs/ /dad pas rtag tu 'grogs par gyis/ /'di la rtag tu rol par gyis/ /de ltar shes rab phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang ste sgom lam sa bcu'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /nyams myong dga' bzhi bskyed pa ni/ rang rdo rje gzhon nu dang / rig ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭ dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ rang gi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag rtse mor phaṭ yig ser po/ yab yum mkhyud pa dang / tsumbha dang / gsang gnas sbyar ba'i 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te thig le dwangs ma rnams zhu/ spyi bo nas 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar byon pas dga' ba/ dbus su byon pas mchog dga'/ rtsa gsum 'dom pa'i gnas su byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/

rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo mthar thug par byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ phyir ba thag tsam yang ma 'dzag par byas te rlung 'pho ba med pa'i gdeng dang bcas pas hūm̐ zhes yar drangs lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' ba/ yar drangs snying kha'i rtsa 'khor gang bas mchog dga'/ yar drangs mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ yar drangs spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsam la/ lus thams cad la rtsas khyab rtsa thams cad la byang sems kyis khyab ste bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang / lam lnga las rgyu'i theg pa mthar phyin pa bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ des yid kyi dri ma dag ste chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin chen la/ /maṇḍal gsol gdab 'bru gsum gyis/ /gdong bcing bsrung la dngos gzhi bsgom/ /gdong phye rtogs bskyed dam tshig bsgrags/ /bsrung zhing gtang rag maṇḍal dang / /longs spyod phul dang spro ba bskyed/ /ces te/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing / bdud rtsi gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas bsrung / dngos gzhi ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pas/ ji ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /skad cig cig la dmigs med pa/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /rang byung ye shes zhes brjod do/

/rang byung gi ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la cung zad mnyam par bzhag 'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs phye/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob/ lam rang byung gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / lam lnga las 'bras bu theg pa mthar phyin pa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ste ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes su gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /rdo rje spun la khros pa ni/ /nyes par brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa yin/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ /byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /de rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin brnyed/ /mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /sngags pas de dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pas bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur/

/de bas sdug bsngal myong gyur te/ /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de gzung bar bya/ /yan lag dam tshig ces bya ba/ /dam tshig dang ni mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rtsod pa dang / /gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang / /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /dam chos gzhan du ston pa dang / /nyan thos dag tu rloms byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun 'das pa dang / /sbyor ba nges par ma byas par/ /skal min gsang ba ston pa dang / /gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas la/ /lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang / /bsnyen sogs dag pa ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa la/ /dgos pa med par 'da' ba rnams/ /kha na ma tho bcas gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /zad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud dang sdug bsngal mang du 'phel/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dam tshig mdor bsdus te bsrung bar bsam la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ gtang rag tu/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gis bskor ba/ hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi po yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/

/thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa bla ma la dbul zhing cha shas kyis longs spyod du gsol snyam pas/ gser dngul byu ru rin po che/ /glang chen ma he nor bur bcas/ /yid la gces pa rnams kyang 'bul/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /bdag gi lus kyang bzhes su gsol/ /lan gsum/ spro ba bskyed pa ni/ slob ma dam pa dam tshig can/ /khyed kyi 'byor tshogs shin tu che/ /dad mos med pas mi 'grub ste/ /dad mos che bas dngos grub thob/ /ces brjod/ spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la sdom ni/ rjes chog la yang srung gtor dang / /tshogs dang bsgral mchod lhag ma btang / /bstan skyong phyogs skyong gshegs su gsol/ /phyi nang mchod bstod dngos grub blangs/ /yon bsngo bzod gsol brten pa lha/ /gtor mgron la sogs rten yod rnams/ /brtan bzhugs rten med gshegs gsol bya/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus te mtshon bskyal zhing / /sbyin sreg bya zhing bdag bsrung la/ /lta bas rgyas btab smon lam dang / /shis pa brjod pa'i rim pa 'o/ /zhes pa las/ srung gtor ni gtor bsngo/ bskang ba dang bstod pa rdo rje'i glu bkra shis rnams so so'i phyag len bzhin brjod/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel mar byed na nub dang po rnams la tshogs bar pa yan grub nas spyi btab kyi thun gtor phul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor shlau ka gsum gyi bkra shis rnams rnga brdung dang bcas pas mdzad/ de nas 'og tu 'chad pa bzhin gyi mchod bstod bsdus pa dang / dngos grub blang zhing bzod gsol rnams bya/ brtan bzhugs gzhan 'dra la/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam sogs nas/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar/ khyad par du yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang /

bum nang du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas sogs brjod/ gtor mgron gyi rten la ma ltos pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang / badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ dam can gshegs pa dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba rnams bdag mdun tha mi dad pa chen po yin pas mi dgos/ oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra sogs nas bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ /nub tha ma la dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham mdzad pas/ rig 'dzin bskul ba 'og tu mdzad/ srung gtor sogs gong bzhin rdo rje'i glu bkra shis yan grub rjes/ tshogs byin rlabs nas/ bar pa bshags pa yan sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po ltar byas la/ bsgral mchod ni/ rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ 'dir bsdus pa sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin la phyi nang gsang ba la ma gtogs/ baiḍūr sngon po mi mdzad/ de nas tshogs bar pa yan grub nas/ dpon slob rnams 'cham chas gyon/ ban phur 'cham rnga khyer/ gzhan 'os babs ji ltar rigs pas sbug chal dang / gser skyems/ gdab phur gsum/ ral gri/ yungs dkar/ rdo rje tho ba/ ras la bris pa'i g.yang gzhi'i snying khar 'brub khung gru gsum me ris dang bcas pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin khyer la/ 'cham rar slebs nas g.yang gzhi slob dpon gyi mdun tsam du bkram/ g.yas phyogs su gdab phur sogs stegs ji ltar rigs par bshams/ spos phor gu gul dang bcas pa yang bzhag go /de nas dgra bgegs grub kyi sngon 'gro sngags 'cham sngags 'chang chen po'i 'cham dpe ltar byas tshar nas nang du log dpon slob ji ltar rigs pas rnga sil dang bcas ling gdan g.yang gzhi bting sar gser skyems byin rlabs byas nas/ bla ma rin chen/ sogs gser skyems bsdus pa rig 'dzin bskul ba sgrub thabs bzhin/

do nub kyi phur kha sogs phur kha bsgyur ba/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka /sogs nas dzaḥdzaḥ'i bar gyis lha srung spyan drangs/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /nas/ ma lus khro rgyal nyid kyi ngang / /zhes dang / kī la ya brjod/ dipta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ /nas/ gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / liṅga bsgral yul zas pa po/ /shlau ka gcig ste gsal ba gsum dang gdeng gsum gsal btab ste nga rgyal bskyed pa/ brgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin dang / /nas/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i grogs mdzod cig /gi bar gyi ma nyes pa'i dpang zug pa rnams 'dur dbyangs dang bcas sngags rnams la rol mo chems brdungs/ tshigs bcad rnams kyi mtshams su rol mo drag brdungs mdzad/ kha 'phang 'di rnams sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs su blta'o/ /de nas bskul dang bcas te dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham sngags 'chang chen po'i 'cham dpe bzhin rdzogs par byas/ ling ga bsgral zhing ling ro 'bul ba rnams grub nas/ nang du log ste thun gtor 'bul ba sogs bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin bya'o/ /nub tha ma zhes pa bsgral ba'i mchod pa'o/ /dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham mi byed par/ dbang tsam bskur ba dang / phyag len bsdus pa bsgrub mchod rkyang pa byed na/ tshogs tha ma bsgral mchod sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin byas nas/ lhag ma/ dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol rdzogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams byed/ rgyas pa'i phyag len 'cham sogs mdzad na/ nangs par tshogs bar pa yan song nas/ lhag ma btang ba ni/ snod gang yang rung bar bsgrub mchod pa'i rigs kyi tshogs lhag bsdus pa rnams blug la mdun du stegs kyi steng du chang bran la bzhag dpon slob rnams kyis rnga sil dang bcas pas/ phaṭ spha ra ṇa/ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas phaṭ byung bar bsam la/

ngag tu mdun gyi ye shes pa'i thugs ka nas phaṭ nag po gcig 'phros te/ rang gi snying khar thim pas/ bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur/ kī la ya nas/ bhyoḥ'i bar gyi sngags thams cad brjod/ de'i rkyen gyis bdag dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gsal lam gyis byung bar bsam/ rol mo bdun brdeg gsum byas nas/ khro bas khro ba sogs nas/ sarba a na ya sogs kyi bar dbyangs dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pas don grub bzhin mdzad/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i ring la ji ltar rigs pas mda' dra/ gdugs skor sgos mchod/ phur btab kyi khro bo bcu'i phur pa rnams bsdus/ phur bu 'o mas bkru ba sogs mi gnang / dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i khyams kyi steng g.yas su rnam rgyal dang / g.yon du las bum bzhag go /bstan skyong ni/ thog mar dpon slob rnams bzhengs te rnga sil dang ldan pas/ dpal ldan 'phrin las kyis pu tra bskul zhing / rim pas sgrub khang gi steng du phebs nas spyi btab nam mkha' 'brug sgra dang bcas te bsrung gtor rnams phul/ de nas bya khyung gi phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan la/ hoḥ bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ sogs nas/ 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin gyis bstan ma'i gtor ma phul zhing / rang gang 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor gyi bkra shis grub mtshams/ phyogs skyong gshegs su gsol ba ni gtang rag gi gtor ma gtong ba yin te/ steng gi shar lho'i mtshams su mchod gtor cho ga rnams phyi rol pa ji lta ba bzhin las/ badzra muḥphyogs skyong rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ /zhes pa tsam ma gtogs 'dra/ de nas mchod g.yog pas spos sna dang gzhan rnams kyis rol mo bcas pas nang du log rim pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum yig brgya 'don bzhin par byas te/

slob dpon shar dang / gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor la 'khod pa dang rol mo bzhag go /phyi nang mchod bstod ni/ spyi mchod rnams kha gsos la byin rlabs bsdus pa bya/ sgeg phreng sogs kyis mchod/ rang byung gdod nas sogs shlau ka gcig gi nang mchod/ sgeg cing dpa' dang sogs kyi bstod pa rnams sta gon gyi rjes chog bzhin bsdus pa mdzad/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sogs lan gsum gdangs dang bcas pa brjod cing thal mo snying khar sbyar/ yon bsngo ba ni slob dpon gyis mchog bsngo dang sbyin bdag gi don du dgos pa byung tshe gshin bsngo gson bsngo sogs skabs thob dang sbyar nas bya'o/ /bzod par gsol ba ni yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs lhag chad kha bskang ba phyi rol pa'i rjes su bya ba bzhin bzod par gsol la brten pa lha phur dang gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams dang brten pa lha'i tshogs rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med gshegs gsol bya ba ni/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor bum nang gi lha gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /sogs gdangs dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing rol mo rnams dkrol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis dam can gyi phur bu nas gtso phur bar rim gyis bsdus shing spyi bor reg gzhan las slob rnams kyis phur gdan dang bum pa gzhan rnams bsdus/ rnam rgyal dang las bum yang bde sar bzhag oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi ā dya nutpanna twad/ ces brjod cing / chos thams cad skye ba med pa de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyis rtsig pa dang por gshegs/ de nas g.yas skor gyis shar gyi me ri nas lte ba'i bar rdo rje'i rtses ri mo 'then/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams gzhan la'ang bya/ de nas sgrub g.yog pa kha cig gis ku sha sogs kyis mtha' nas bsdus te/ rin po che legs pa'i snod gtsang mar blugs/ slob dpon gyis las bum sogs kyi bum chus thig rjes rnams rim pa bzhin gyis rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /tshon bskyal ba ni/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba'i rgyas pa'am bsdus pa dkyil 'khor rgyal chog nas 'byung ba bzhin bya ste/ phyag len la mi mdzad/ sbyin sreg ni/ grub na skabs 'dir sa los mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rdo rje'i me 'od dang dkyil chog bzhin no/ /'on kyang ding sang mi mdzad/ bdag bsrung ba ni/ oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra kro dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam/ oṃ badzra ka wa tsi hūm̐ phaṭ kyis rdo rje'i go gyon par bsam pa'o/ /lta bas rgyas btab pa ni/ rang bzhin sems kyi sogs shlau ka phyed dang gnyis dang a kā ro sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar brjod cing chos thams cad gdod nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go

/smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /sogs shlau ka gcig sgrub thabs bzhin dang / dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /sogs bsngo smon gang shes bya'o/ /shis pa brjod pa ni/ dpon slob rnams la me tog nas bkye la/ dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ bla ma'i bkra shis gang shes dang / hūm̐/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas pa brjod cing / dkyil 'khor gyi shul sogs la me tog gi char dbab cing / bkra shis par bya ba ste/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs thams cad bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor du rtogs par bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs la sa chog tho 'dzugs pa/ bum pa 'god pa mi mdzad gzhan zur 'debs bzhin no/ /nub phyi ma la bsgral mchod sogs mdzad pa ste phyag len gyi rim pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ ding sang snyigs ma bas kyang cher snyigs pas/ /gsang sngags rgya mtshor blo sbyangs lta zhog gi /cho ga'i tshig rigs tsam gyi go rim la'ang / /rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams snying nas ma bzod de/ /dang po'i las can 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ /skyes chen gong ma'i gsung rab phyogs cig bsdebs/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams te/ /yi ge'i 'du byed rigs rus cho 'brangs can/ /mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /skyes dang sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod cher yangs pas/ /snyan ngag la sogs rig gnas mtha' dag dang / /khyad par dus 'khor rtsis gzhung rgya mtsho la/ /mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa de nyid do/ /bstan chos 'di nyid dkar mo nyi zla dang / /bdud rgyal nag po phur bsrungs bcu gnyis la/
